outline:
This course delves into biomaterials engineered for both internal and external applications in the human body, integrating principles of molecular biology. For internal applications, the materials include drug delivery systems that leverage molecular mechanisms for precise targeting, artificial skin designed to mimic cellular structures and promote regeneration, and artificial blood developed through an understanding of protein interactions and cell signaling pathways. For external applications, the materials encompass diagnostic sensor technologies that detect molecular biomarkers, dialysis modules crafted to filter out waste at the cellular level, and external artificial lungs that replicate gas exchange processes at the molecular scale.

本課程深入探討整合分子生物學原理，為人體內部和外部應用設計的生物材料。內部應用方面的材料包括利用分子機制進行精準定位的藥物傳遞系統、模仿細胞結構並促進再生的人工皮膚，以及通過理解蛋白質相互作用和細胞信號傳導途徑而開發的人工血液。外部應用方面的材料包括檢測分子生物標記的診斷感測技術、能在細胞層面過濾廢物的透析模組，以及模擬分子水平氣體交換過程的外部人工肺。
